title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: amendment fees must be on the account before a review is decided
content:
## Rule
Every amendment fee owed on the acceptance's signed amendments is booked before its review is decided.

Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product the chargeable amendments are the signed amendments on the acceptance beyond the category's number of free amendments, never fewer than none, and the amendment-fee rows on the acceptance's account must be at least as many. Where the amendment-fee rows are fewer than the chargeable amendments, the review is not decided.

## Condition → outcome
| Amendment-fee rows on the account, compared with chargeable amendments | Condition for deciding the review |
|---|---|
| at least as many | met |
| fewer | not met — the review is not decided |

## Worked cases (hypothetical allowance of 1 free amendment)
| Signed amendments | Chargeable amendments | Amendment-fee rows on the account | Condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | none | 0 | met |
| 1 | none | 0 | met |
| 3 | 2 | 1 | not met |
| 3 | 2 | 2 | met |

## Points of judgement
- *Which amendments are counted as signed?* The acceptance's amendment declarations whose outcome is signed.
- *Is a re-review fee row counted with the amendment-fee rows?* No; only rows charged as amendment fees are compared with the chargeable amendments.
